rationale: The file contains two instances of `time.Now()` that directly influence ledger writes via `PutState()`. Line 95 in `initLedger()` assigns `Timestamp: time.Now()` to Med objects that are subsequently serialized and written to state (L101). Line 127 in `getUpdatedObject()` assigns `Timestamp: time.Now()` to a Med object returned to `createMed()`, which then calls `PutState()` (L119). These time values are consensus-critical because different endorsing peers will capture different wall-clock times, causing the serialized Med objects to differ and endorsement to diverge.
